buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 3. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Generic Malicious Code Certificate: The seller should upload following certificate in the bid:- (a) This is to certify that the Hardware and the Software being offered, as part of the contract, does not contain Embedded Malicious code that would activate procedures to :- (i) Inhibit the desires and designed function of the equipment. (ii) Cause physical damage to the user or equipment during the exploitation. (iii) Tap information resident or transient in the equipment/network. (b) The firm will be considered to be in breach of the procurement contract, in case physical damage, loss of information or infringements related to copyright and Intellectual Property Right (IPRs) are caused due to activation of any such malicious code in embedded software. 8. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 9. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 10. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 11. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Payment online through RTGS / internet banking also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). On-line payment shall be in Beneficiary name KENDRIYA VIDYALAYA NO 1 AFS HALWARA VVN ACCOUNT Account No. 172701000006602 IFSC Code IOBA0001727 Bank Name INDIAN OVERSEAS BANK Branch address HALWARA . Successful Bidder to indicate Contract number and name of Seller entity in the transaction details field at the time of on-line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer in place of PBG within 15 days of award of contract. 12. Generic The buyer organization is an institution eligible for concessional rates of GST as notified by the Government of India. The services for which bids have been invited fall under classification of GST concession and the conditions for eligibility of concession are met by the institution. A certificate to this effect will be issued by Buyer to the Seller after award of the Contract. Sellers are requested to submit their bids after accounting for the Concessional rate of GST. Applicable Concessional rate of GST :

0 % Notification No.and date : dated 28/06/2017 13. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 14. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS : 1. All bids shall be submitted online through GEM's Portal and any other means of ubmitting the bid, other than the GEM's Portal will not be entertained. 2. Each page of the relevant/supporting documents submitted by the bidders shoul d be signed digitally or otherwise and then shall be uploaded to the GEM's Portal . 3. Principal of Kendriya Vidyalaya No. 1 AFS Halwara (hereinafter referred to as "PR INCIPAL") reserves the right to postpone and/or extend the date of receipt/openi ng of rates/bids online or to withdraw the same, without assigning a reason ther eof. 4. The Bidder must comply with the rates/quotations, specifications and all terms a nd conditions of the contract. No deviation in the Terms and Conditions of the co ntract shall be entertained unless specifically mentioned by the bidder in the rat es/quotations and accepted by the Principal. 5. The contract will be awarded initially for a period of 12 months. 6. The unskilled labours employed should not be below 18 years of age and they ould be medically fit. Bidders should have been providing similar services to any Government Departments/Government undertaking and having good reputation for at least last three years. 7. Working days for unskilled labour will be from Monday to Saturday every week.

Working hours will be between 07:30 am to 04:30 pm per day including one- hour lunch break. Sunday or any gazzetteed holiday will be off. However, in certain circumstances, they may be called on duty on gazzetted holidays or on Sunday. 8. The unskilled labour can be deployed to work beyond office hours also if so required. 9. Arrangement of proper substitute should be made immediately in case of absence of any labour. In case of providing the substitute, the cost of engaging a labour will be borne by contractor. 10. The service provider shall provide a substitute if any labour leaves the job due to his/her personal reason. 11. The supplier / service provider shall provide to the labour so engaged or to be eng aged by him for rendering the aforesaid services at his own expenses and shall al so ensure that the uniforms are clean, tidy and are worn by them at all time while on duty. They shall carry their identity Card with them. Persons deployed by servi ce provider should be polite, efficient, disciplined and having positive attitude tow ards the work. 12. If any damage other than normal wear and tear is done by the labour engaged to this office property, the cost will be recovered from contractor. 13. The Contractor will maintain records such as Photos, full address and telephone n umber of all housekeeping personnel and will submit when it is called for. The det ails of all the laborer to be deployed by him will be submitted in the following prof orma to this office for providing the service along with Police Verification Certifica te certifying that there is no criminal case pending against them within 15 days o f commencement of tender. The service provider should have the PSARA of Punja b state only. S.N. Name, Residential ad Date of Birth Document showing proof of Na dress and Mobile No. me and address in respect of t of staff provided he staff will be submitted by th e service provider. 14. The Contractor should strictly follow Latest Minimum Wages Act of Govt of India and other allied Labour Laws and it is also the responsibility of t he Contractor to subscribe to Employees Provident Fund, Insurance Sch eme ete & other statutory schemes as notified by Central Government, State Government from time to time. Revised rates of minimum wages given by the Govt. of India will be applicable during the contract period.

15. The Contractor will submit the challans of payment of ESI and PF for each month. The contractor shall submit on periodic basis the proof of payment of ESI & PF, fai lure of which monthly payment of the Contractor shall be withheld for want of pro of of such payment. 16. The deduction towards EPF and ESI etc., be incorporated in rates being quoted per persons per month basis and the same would not be payable over and above rates thus quoted. 17. The Service Provider shall provide full information in respect of the wages etc. pai d to its employees so deployed in conformity with the provisions of Contract Labo ur (Regulations and Abolition) Act, 1970 or any other law in force for the time bei ng. 18. The Head-office of the service provider must be registered in Punjab sta te only. 19. The firm must have an annual turnover of Rs. 15 Lac or more every year during last 3 years from this business. Copies of proof in this regard sh ould be uploaded. 20. The firm must have experience of 03 years in the similar field. Copies of proof in this regard should be uploaded. 21. Condition of prior experience with respect of Micro & Small Enterprises/ Start-up i s relaxed subject to meeting of quality & technical specification. 22. The Office of Principal, Kendriya Vidyalaya No 1 AFS Halwara shall not entertain a ny claim arising out of any mishap, if any, which may take place and in the event of any liability/ claim falling on this office, the same shall be reimbursed / indemni fied by the contractor. 23. The Contractor shall be responsible for fulfilling all his obligations towards the persons deployed under law, namely under the Latest Minimum wages Act of Govt of India, Bonus Act, Maternity Benefits Act, Shops and Establishment Act etc. and applic able from time to time.

24. It is made clear that the engagement of the service provider does not in any way confer any right to the service provider or the persons that may be deployed by h im in this office for claiming any regular or part time employment in this office an d the labours shall have no claim for employment or absorption/regularization of s ervices in this office. 25. Service provider shall replace immediately any of its labour if he is unacceptable t o this office because of security risk, incompetence, breach of confidentiality or i mproper conduct upon receiving written notice from this office. 26. The office reserves the right to terminate the contract at any time by giving one month notice to the contractor. 27. Payment to the service provider will be made on monthly basis on prese ntation of the wages bill. TDS shall be deducted at source as per the rat es notified by the Income Tax Department. Following documents are req uired for payment of bill. A) Invoice, B) Salary statement (Gross salary w ith EPF& ESI, Deduction and Net payment), C) Biometric attendance of a ll staff, D) Bank Statement of Net payment with the copy of bank passb ook of all staff, E) Paid challan of ESI, F) Paid challan of EPF with the co py of passbook EPF account of all staff. 28. The Service Provider is responsible for payment of monthly salary to the personn el as applicable to them under Law. The Service Provider should ensure that wages are paid on time by the 3rd day of every month. 29. It is the sole responsibility of the Service Provider to ensure security and safety of all property and assets, movable and immovable in the office premises and if ther e is any loss on account of negligence, dishonesty, connivance, theft etc. by the person deployed by Contractor, he (the contractor) shall indemnify this office for such loss. 30. No other person except Service Provider's authorized representative shall be allo wed to enter the School premises. The contractor shall in no case further lease/transfe

r/ sublet or appoint any caretaker for the services. 31. Department will not be responsible for any dispute between Service Provider and workers of the Service Provider. 32. The Service Providers are required to submit the complete rates/quotations only after satisfying each and every condition laid down in the terms and conditions. D epartment reserves right to terminate contract during the period if its operations of services are found to be not satisfactory by giving one-month notice. 33. During summer vacation, autumn break, winter break conservancy labour will be called for service as per requirement of the Vidyalaya. Care giver aaya is being ap pointed to take care of balvatika students. If Balvatika class is off then Care giver aaya will also not be called for duty. If the day is holiday for balvatika class then c are giver aaya will not be called. 34. The bidders are bound to accept all terms and conditions written in the bid docu ments. This undertaking must be submitted on their letterhead along with other d ocuments. 35. The Agency’s Staff shall not disturb the employees of the Institution or make any sort of noise in the Institutions premises. 36. The Agency’s workers should be polite, courteous, well-behaved and honest. 37. The Agency shall be fully responsible and liable for any theft, burglary, fire or any other mischievous deed done by its workers. 38. The antecedents of all the workers will be verified from police by the Agency befo re deployment 5 / 7 for work. The Police Verification Certificate of each individual to be engaged by the Contractor along with their Profiles & photos should be sub mitted by the contractor. The Contractor shall not change the persons engaged without prior approval of the PRINCIPAL. If, under unavoidable circumstances, an y replacement is to be made, the Contractor shall provide his Police Verification Certificate, Profile & Photo to the PRINCIPAL at the time of introducing the new p erson/replacement. Replacement of any staff will be done with the permission of Principal. 39. The Agency’s workers shall not enter into any unlawful activity within the KV

premises and shall have a good moral character. 40. The Institute shall have the right to impose cash penalty on the contractor or ded uct such amount from its security deposit in case the Institution is put to any fina ncial loss directly or indirectly by any act of omission or commission on the part o f the Contractor’s workers. 41. Insurance and accident risks of the workers will be the responsibility of the Agenc y. 42. The Agency shall in no case transfer the services. The Contracting Agency only sh all provide the services for which the contract has been signed. 43. The Institute reserves the right to order any worker of the Agency to leave the premises of the Institute, if his presence at any time is felt undesirable. 44. KV No 1 AFS Halwara is a “No Tobacco Zone”, the contractor shall ensure that em ployees engaged by the firm don’t take tobacco or alcohol in any form in the KV premises. 45. Salary of the employees deployed by the agency must be credited in the bank acc ount of the concerned staff with in the first three days of the month (for example salary for the month of January must be credited by the 03rd feb) otherwise actio n will be taken as per GeM policy. 46. Successful bidder will install bio metric attendance machine in the school premise s before starting the contract for the employees deployed otherwise payment will not be made. 47. Address mentioned in EPF registration, ESI registration, labour license (if applicable) and firm Registration should be same. If all four documents having different addre ss, bidder will be liable to disqualify during technical evaluation. 48. Failing to fulfil any of the above conditions mentioned in Bid, will automatically lead to termination of contract with stipulated action. 49. Successful bidder will submit the list of employes as mentioned below within a we ek after awarding the contract for selection of employees: - A) List of 06 employees for conservancy B) List of 06 employees for security guard C) List of 02 employees for gardener D) List of 02 employees for care giver aaya. Sch ool committee will select the employee as mentioned in the bid on the basis of criteri

a decided by the school administration. 49. Qualification for caregiver or helper shall be as prescribed by NCERT/ NCPCR. i. · Secondary class (Class X or its equivalent) from a recognised board, minimum 18 years of age and should have induction training in pre- school Education. Or Any person possessing skill training / adequate training as prescribed by NIPCCD, NSDC or any other institution recognised by the central Government/ appropriate Government/ Recognised University /Board. * Salary for helpers shall be as per the rates applicable for semi-skilled people. 50. Bidder should upload all required documents in one ‘pdf’ in below mentioned seq uence with index, if not then technical evaluation of such bidders will not be done and bi dder will be disqualified during technical evaluation. SN NAME OF DOCUMENT PAGE NO. 01 Labour licence (Conservancy) 02 Firm Registraion 03 EPF Registration 04 ESI Registraion 05 Copy of PAN 06 Copy of GSTIN 07 PSARA of Punjab State only 08 Audited balance sheet of last three years i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26

09 IT Return of last three years i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 10 Experience Certificate on the basis of con tract made through GeM 11 Police Verification of owner, should be iss ued on or after 31.10.2026 12 Undertaking for Bankrupt / under liquidati on / Non- Black listed 13 MSME 14 Duly signed acceptance of all terms and conditions on the letterhead of firm 15 Pre contract integrity pact duly signed by the authorized signatory VALIDITY: The contract will be valid for a period of one year. However, the contract can be exte nded for further period which should be agreeable to both parties. On expiry of the contract, the service provider should withdraw its personnel and clear his accounts by paying all his legal dues. . 15.
